## English

### New

- The plugin store listing now includes a custom icon and featured artwork.

## 中文

### 新功能

- 插件商店页面现已展示自定义图标和精选宣传图。

new: 现在可以为每个笔记本选择图标，并在笔记本摘要中查看所选图标。
fixes: 旧版宿主现在可以使用插件所需的存储和界面权限。

README 现已加入图标选择器的动态演示。
插件现在通过内置的 JavaScript 沙箱运行区块图标功能。

new: You can now choose an icon for each notebook and see the selected icon in notebook summaries.
fixes: Older hosts can now access the storage and UI permissions required by the plugin.

The README now includes animated demonstrations of the icon picker.
The plugin now runs block icon features in the built-in JavaScript sandbox.

releases.body:
## English

### New

- You can now choose an icon for each notebook and see the selected icon in notebook summaries.

### Fixes

- Older hosts can now access the storage and UI permissions required by the plugin.

### Other

- The plugin no longer requests exempt storage and UI permissions.
- The README now includes animated demonstrations of the icon picker.
- The plugin now runs block icon features in the built-in JavaScript sandbox.

---

## 中文

### 新功能

- 现在可以为每个笔记本选择图标，并在笔记本摘要中查看所选图标。

### 修复

- 旧版宿主现在可以使用插件所需的存储和界面权限。

### 其他

- 插件现在不再申请可豁免的存储和界面权限。
- README 现已加入图标选择器的动态演示。
- 插件现在通过内置的 JavaScript 沙箱运行区块图标功能。

other: 本次为维护版本，没有面向用户的变化。
